info.name: AuthKit IAM & OIDC Provider API Suite
info.description: Exhaustive Postman Collection for AuthKit (Identity & Access Management microservice). Organized into 10 logical workflow folders covering Health, Authentication, Magic Links, MFA, OAuth, User Profile, Sessions, Admin Controls, OIDC Provider Protocols, and Custom OIDC Interaction Flows.

item.name: 01. Service Health & Diagnostics
item.description: Endpoints to check API status and service availability.

request.description: Returns basic service status message.
Basic server health check.
Detailed health check including database, Redis status, uptime, and memory usage.

item.name: 02. Authentication & Account Lifecycle
item.description: User registration, email verification, credentials authentication, token rotation, and password reset flows.

request.description: Registers a new user account with unverified email status and dispatches welcome/verification emails.

item.name: Register User Account (Edge Case - Duplicate Email)

request.description: Edge Case: Attempting to register an already registered email address returns 400 Bad Request.
Verifies the user's email address using the token delivered via email or logs/emails/*.html.
Resends the email verification notification.
Authenticates credentials and returns access and refresh tokens.
Edge Case: Rejects login attempt for unverified email accounts with 400 Bad Request.
Edge Case: Enforces 15-minute account lockout after 5 consecutive failed password attempts.
Rotates refresh token and issues a new access token using the refreshToken HttpOnly cookie.
Dispatches a 6-digit OTP code to the user's email for password reset.
Verifies the 6-digit reset OTP and sets a password reset session cookie.
Resets the user password using the reset token derived from the cookie payload.
Changes authenticated user's password and revokes all active sessions.
Logs out the authenticated user, revokes session in DB, and purges Redis token cache.

item.name: 03. Passwordless (Magic Link)
item.description: Magic link login request and token verification flows.

request.description: Generates a magic link token and sends a login link to the recipient.
Verifies magic link token and authenticates the user, setting session cookies.

item.name: 04. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
item.description: MFA setup, TOTP verification, login challenges, and backup code recovery.

request.description: Generates a TOTP secret key and QR code data URL for MFA enrollment.
Verifies 6-digit TOTP code, enables 2FA on the account, and returns 5 backup recovery codes.
Verifies MFA TOTP code during login challenge (uses mfaLoginToken cookie).

item.name: Verify MFA Challenge with Backup Code

request.description: Consumes a single-use backup recovery code during MFA login challenge.
Disables MFA on user account (password verified if account has password credentials).

item.name: 05. Social Authentication (OAuth 2.0)
item.description: Google OAuth 2.0 redirection and callback endpoints.

request.description: Initiates Google OAuth 2.0 login handshake.
OAuth 2.0 authorization code callback handler for Google provider.
Returns profile details for the currently authenticated user.

item.name: 07. Session Management
item.description: Active session query, paginated listing, and session revocation endpoints.

request.description: Retrieves active user sessions using cursor-based pagination with X-Total-Count headers.
Fetches metadata for a specific session ID.
Revokes a specific active session by ID.
Revokes all active sessions for the current user except the current session.

item.name: 08. Admin Controls & Role Management
item.description: Admin user management, role escalation, session revocation, and OIDC client registration endpoints.

request.description: Promotes target user role from USER to ADMIN.
Queries all registered users with cursor-based pagination.

item.name: Get Specific User Profile by ID

request.description: Retrieves user details by user ID.
Deletes target user account and all associated sessions and credentials.
Lists all active sessions belonging to target user ID.
Revokes all active sessions for target user ID.
Admin endpoint to revoke any session by session ID.
Registers a new OIDC client application and generates credentials.
Queries security audit logs with cursor-based pagination and filtering by action, status, userId, or date ranges.

item.name: Get Audit Log Details by ID

request.description: Retrieves audit log details by log ID with sensitive metadata fields redacted.

item.name: Webhooks & Outbound Events
item.description: Webhook subscription management, HMAC secret rotation, test event delivery, and delivery audit history.

request.description: Creates a new webhook subscription and generates a cryptographically secure signing secret.
Retrieves paginated webhook subscriptions.
Retrieves details of a specific webhook subscription.
Updates webhook subscription configuration, URL, events, or status.
Rotates signing secret for a webhook subscription with a 24-hour dual-signature grace window.
Triggers a test webhook event delivery attempt to verify receiver endpoint health.
Retrieves paginated delivery attempt history for a webhook subscription.
Retrieves details of a specific webhook delivery attempt.
Deletes a webhook subscription and its associated delivery records.

item.name: 09. OpenID Connect (OIDC 1.0) Provider Protocols
item.description: Standard OIDC 1.0 Discovery, JWKS, Authorization Code, Token, UserInfo, Introspection, and Revocation endpoints.

request.description: Fetches OIDC Provider discovery configuration metadata.

item.name: OIDC Public JSON Web Key Set (JWKS)

request.description: Returns public RSA signing keys for token verification.
Starts OIDC Authorization Code Flow with PKCE parameters.
Exchanges authorization code for ID, Access, and Refresh tokens.
Returns user claims associated with the OIDC access token.
Introspects token state and validity.
Revokes active OIDC access or refresh token.

item.name: 10. OIDC Custom Interaction Flows
item.description: Custom session bridge and interaction prompt endpoints used during OIDC login/consent.

item.name: Render OIDC Interaction Details & Session Bridge Check

request.description: Retrieves interaction prompt details. Evaluates active Direct API session cookie for automatic Session Bridge authentication.
Submits credentials for OIDC interaction prompt.

item.name: Submit OIDC Interaction MFA Challenge Code

request.description: Submits TOTP code for MFA-enabled accounts during OIDC interaction.
Confirms user consent for requested OIDC scopes.
Aborts OIDC interaction prompt.

item.name: 11. Passkeys & WebAuthn
item.description: Passkey registration, passwordless authentication, MFA verification, and authenticator management endpoints.

request.description: Generates cryptographic options and random challenge for registering a new passkey.
Verifies authenticator attestation response and persists the passkey credential.
Generates assertion options and random challenge for passwordless passkey login.
Verifies passkey assertion, logs in user, creates session, and issues tokens.
Verifies passkey assertion as a secondary factor during MFA challenge.
Returns all passkey authenticators registered to the authenticated user.
Updates the friendly name/label of a registered passkey.
Deletes a passkey authenticator owned by the authenticated user.
